caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned upright and facing slightly to the right. The chair is composed of carved wooden elements, with the frame and legs colored in shades of reddish-brown. The backrest features a decorative arched top edge and vertical slats, with turned posts on either side that are intricately shaped. The seat of the chair is made from a pale, woven material, possibly straw or cane, forming a smooth triangular surface. The legs of the chair are sturdy and turned, connected by multiple stretchers, including horizontal and diagonal ones, with additional carved detailing, such as spherical elements on the central stretcher. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast and allowing the details of the chair to be clearly seen.
title: Side Chair
